# Profile Research Briefs

Structured briefs on a list of people.

Use for briefs on two or more accounts. Not for one account (who-is-this-person).

**The user might say:** "Write a short, sourced brief on each of these accounts: @[handles]"

## Steps

1. Each account.
   ```sh
   xholic people get --username <handle>
   ```
2. A short, sourced brief per account. Only what the data shows.
